fidelity: F2a — ASF Kinetics + Lumped Exothermic Thermal ODE
source: Dry, M.E. (2002) Catal. Today 71:227; Anderson, R.B. (1984) The Fischer-Tropsch Synthesis, Academic Press (ASF distribution); Yates & Satterfield (1991) Energy Fuels 5:168 (LHHW CO rate, cobalt); Steynberg & Dry (2004) Fischer-Tropsch Technology, Elsevier

unit.name: Generic Low-Temperature Fischer-Tropsch Reactor (Cobalt catalyst, slurry/fixed-bed)

alpha_ASF.note: ASF chain-growth probability (LTFT cobalt); set by T,P,H2/CO

k0_FT.note: LHHW pre-exponential, Yates-Satterfield form (cobalt), calibrated so single-pass CO conversion ~0.5-0.7 at 220degC matches Dry (2002)/F1a

Ea_FT.note: Apparent activation energy for CO consumption (cobalt LTFT)

dH_rxn_per_CO.note: Exothermic heat released per mol CO converted (-CH2- + H2O), Dry 2002

H2_CO_ratio.note: Syngas H2:CO molar feed ratio (FT stoichiometry CO+2H2)

LHV_FT_liquid_MJ_kg.note: LHV of FT C5+ liquid product (diesel-equivalent)

UA_cool.note: Overall cooling duty coefficient * area (boiling-water jacket). FT is strongly exothermic (~MW scale); sized so steady T~500K with Q_gen=Q_cool. Heat removal is the critical design constraint (Dry 2002)
